caption: The drawing features a symmetrical pattern consisting mainly of stylized floral motifs. In the central area, there are eight arrangements of flowers, each having three petals; the petals alternate between yellow and red, with some flowers having two yellow and one red petal and others having two red and one yellow petal. The flowers have green stems and leaves, with each flower surrounded by six elongated green leaves fanned out symmetrically. Along the left and bottom borders, there are green, curved bands with small yellow and red three-petal flowers placed where the band curves upward. The background within the top left and bottom borders, behind the bands, has a cross-hatched, textured pattern in light gray. The rest of the background is cream or off-white. The drawing is signed “J.R. TOWERS DEL. 133” in the bottom right corner.
title: Applique Coverlet
